title: Resume details
description: Your resume facts. CEZ Job Finder reads this file every time it makes a resume for you.

month.description: Year then month, like 2023-02 for February 2023. A year alone, like 2023, when you only know the year - the page then shows years only.

bullets.description: One thing you did, per line. Keep each to a single sentence.

contact.description: Your name and how an employer reaches you.

name.description: The name that goes at the top of the page.

location.description: Town and state, like Springfield, IL.

links.description: LinkedIn, a portfolio, anything worth a click.

headline.description: One line above your summary saying what you do - your real title and main skills, like Software Engineer | React.js, TypeScript, Node.js. Leave it out if you prefer none.

summary.description: The short pitch at the top of the page - up to four lines.

roles.description: Your jobs, newest first. Leave it as [] if you have not had one yet.

company.description: The employer's name, written the way they write it.

title.description: Your job title, spelled out - Senior, not Sr.

blurb.description: One line on what the employer does, if it is not obvious.

oneOf.description: The job you are in now.

ai_era.description: Set this only to overrule the dates about whether AI work belongs in this job.

career_break.description: Time away from work, said plainly. Shown with your jobs in date order, without any lines under it.

reason.description: A few words, like Caring for a family member. Shown as Career break - your words.

projects.description: Worth showing but not a job: side projects, teaching. Dates may be left out; give both or neither.

skills.description: The skills block at the bottom of the page.

items.description: The words listed under that heading.

degree.description: BA, AA, certificate, whatever it was called.

hide_year.description: true leaves the year off the page. Worth it for a degree finished 15 or more years ago.

certifications.description: Licences and certifications. Leave it as [] if you have none.

languages.description: Languages you speak, one per line, level in brackets: Spanish (Fluent). Levels: Native, Fluent, Professional, Conversational, Basic.

other.description: Anything else worth a heading of its own: volunteer work, awards, a security clearance, publications. Printed exactly as written, after your certifications.

heading.description: The section heading, like Volunteer Work.

lines.description: One line each. Put any dates inside the line.
